items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ron somebody was his name. Jesus, it’s gonna come in my head in a minute. He had an apartment in Lugano.

ctx.x: The Apple label. Ron somebody was his name. Jesus, it’s gonna come in my head in a minute. He had an apartment in Lugano. The Garden Spot of the World in Switzerland? The Italian Alps?
The first album was Under the Jasmine Tree, which had some different music on it compared to what you guys used to play.
